---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest something IWC could do that it doesn't yet.
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
---

## What would you like IWC to do?

A clear description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Why is this useful?

What problem does it solve, or what workflow does it speed up? If
there's an existing way to do it that's awkward, describe that too.

## Are there any references?

If the feature exists in another radio-control app, on the radio's front
panel, or in a similar logging / control program — please link or
describe so I can see how it's typically presented.

## Which radio(s) and operating mode(s) would benefit?

Some features only apply to certain radios or modes. Helps me work
out scope.
